source.rationale: Prevents duplicate character identity and weapon residue in reference-image regeneration.

notes: Use when a single foreground character with a katana/sword contaminates background signage, holograms, or reflections.

failure_taxonomy.repair_strategy: keep exactly one foreground character and remove identity-like background copies
keep the weapon as one foreground object and suppress weapon-like background residue
prioritize explicit character-body-side contact graph over visual guesswork

object_instance_rules: character: exactly one visible instance, foreground only
katana or sword: exactly one foreground object only
no weapon-like silhouettes, signage, reflections, shadows, or repeated motifs in the background
preserve anatomical left/right hand assignments exactly as written
do not swap viewer-left/viewer-right with character-left/character-right
hands must contact only their assigned object parts
background_quality_rules: background may contain abstract neon signage but no human face billboard
no portrait hologram, character-shaped signage, or second character silhouette
wet reflections must be smooth color reflections, not blade-shaped reflections
background simplicity has higher priority than background detail
simplify or blur background details that resemble weapons
prefer smooth organized composition over dense distant micro-details
do_not_copy_from_reference: do not copy the reference character into background signage, holograms, billboards, or reflections
do not repeat katana or weapon motifs in background signage or wet reflections
conflict_resolution: If background detail conflicts with object integrity, prefer object integrity.
If wet reflections create object residue, simplify or blur the reflection.
positive_anchors: one foreground character with the intended face, hair, outfit, and pose
single foreground weapon attached to the intended hand/contact point
